# discord_permissions (Data Source)

Computes Discord permission integers from named permission flags. Use allow_bits/permissions with roles, and allow_bits plus deny_bits with channel permission overwrites.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    discord = {
      source  = "tfstack/discord"
      version = "~> 1.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "discord" {}

# Build a readable role permission bitmask
data "discord_permissions" "moderator" {
  kick_members         = "allow"
  ban_members          = "allow"
  manage_messages      = "allow"
  moderate_members     = "allow"
  view_channel         = "allow"
  send_messages        = "allow"
  read_message_history = "allow"
}

# Channel overwrite: allow send, deny manage
data "discord_permissions" "channel_mod" {
  view_channel    = "allow"
  send_messages   = "allow"
  manage_messages = "deny"
}

# Example role using computed permissions
resource "discord_role" "moderator" {
  name        = "Moderator"
  guild_id    = "1452601985235816601" # Replace with your guild ID
  permissions = data.discord_permissions.moderator.permissions
}

output "moderator_permissions" {
  value = data.discord_permissions.moderator.permissions
}

output "channel_allow_bits" {
  value = data.discord_permissions.channel_mod.allow_bits
}

output "channel_deny_bits" {
  value = data.discord_permissions.channel_mod.deny_bits
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `add_reactions` (String) Set the `add_reactions` permission bit to `allow`, `deny`, or `unset` (default).
- `administrator` (String) Set the `administrator` permission bit to `allow`, `deny`, or `unset` (default).
- `allow_extends` (Number) Base allow permission bits to extend (OR'd with flags set to allow).
- `attach_files` (String) Set the `attach_files` permission bit to `allow`, `deny`, or `unset` (default).

### Read-Only

- `allow_bits` (Number) Computed allow permission bits for use with role permissions or channel overwrite allow.
- `deny_bits` (Number) Computed deny permission bits for use with channel overwrite deny.
- `permissions` (Number) Alias of allow_bits for convenient use with discord_role.permissions and discord_everyone_role.permissions.
